convert_motor_angles_to_leg_pose: convert eight motor angles to a leg pose array with swing and extension values for all four legs
convert_leg_pose_to_motor_angles: convert a leg pose array with swing and extension values back to eight motor angles
convert_leg_pose_to_motor_angles_with_sa: convert swing extension poses to motor angles with safety limits to prevent legs from hitting the robot body
calculate_single_leg_motor_angles: calculate motor positions for a single leg given its swing angle and extension level with optional noise
create_minitaur_pose_object: create a MinitaurPose object with configurable swing and extension angles for all four legs using attrs
